title: The Shim Syndicate — Master Registry
description: Canonical version registry for The Shim Syndicate. This file tracks which version of the Syndicate is active and provides a complete audit trail of version history. Every project hydrated from this core records this version at hydration time.

versions.description: Test Doctrine Integration. Introduces templates/TEST_DOCTRINE.md as a two-tier testing specification system. Universal philosophy in the core template; project-specific instantiation in .syndicate/TEST_DOCTRINE.md at hydration time. Extends syndicate-init.sh to stamp the template, updates the pre-commit hook to enforce doctrine integrity, and wires ORACLE.md §4 to reference the doctrine file.
changelog: Added templates/TEST_DOCTRINE.md v1.0 — Universal test taxonomy (Unit/Service/Endpoint/Integration), five composability axioms (AX-1 through AX-5), Gavel audit criteria for test quality, test organization standards, and placeholder sections for project-specific instantiation.

Updated scripts/syndicate-init.sh v2.1 — Added Step 4.1: stamps TEST_DOCTRINE.md from template into .syndicate/ at project hydration time, substituting PROJECT_NAME, SYNDICATE_VERSION, HYDRATION_DATE, and OPERATOR_NAME. Updated Step 6 to include test_doctrine path in config.json. Updated mission mode (Step 12) to also stamp TEST_DOCTRINE.md into mission vault.

Updated hooks/pre-commit v2.1 — Added CHECK-5: Test Doctrine Integrity. Verifies .syndicate/TEST_DOCTRINE.md exists (WARN if absent) and contains no unfilled {{placeholder}} tokens (FAIL if present). Updated check count from 4 to 5.
Updated templates/ORACLE.md — Added §4.4 Testing Doctrine with TEST_DOCTRINE path reference and description of the Doctrine's role relative to coverage thresholds.

versions.description: Efficiency Tier Integration. Adds Phase 0 Confidence Gate, Surgical Scope, and Tool Minimalism (Silent Drip) to @lead and @operative. Formalizes sub-agent model routing in the Delegation Matrix. Introduces sops/CONTEXT_HYGIENE.md as an operator SOP for session lifecycle management. Adds Session Resource Budget to ORACLE.md template.
changelog: Updated THE_LEAD.md v3.1 — Added Phase 0: Confidence Gate with explicit trigger conditions and interrogation protocol before any execution phase.
Updated THE_LEAD.md v3.1 — Added Operational Philosophy §5 Surgical Scope: targeted file reads, no undirected directory scanning.
Updated THE_LEAD.md v3.1 — Added Operational Philosophy §6 Tool Minimalism (Silent Drip): CLI-first, MCP tools only for capabilities unavailable via CLI.

Updated THE_LEAD.md v3.1 — Expanded Delegation Matrix with explicit Operative Model Binding table: task type to model binding (Haiku/Flash for research, Sonnet/Pro for implementation, local for audit, nested sub-agent for 3+ file surveys).
Updated THE_OPERATIVE.md v1.1 — Added Surgical Scope and Tool Minimalism to Operational Philosophy. Sub-agents return actionable delta only — no raw content.

Created sops/CONTEXT_HYGIENE.md v1.0 — Operator SOP for session lifecycle: Snapshot & Compact procedure, 5-minute cache boundary recovery, Session Handoff Block format, anti-pattern register. CLI-specific commands (/compact, /context, /cost, /clear) correctly scoped to operator SOP rather than agent identity files.

Updated templates/ORACLE.md — Added §6.4 Session Resource Budget with configurable thresholds for context hygiene trigger, operative delegation threshold, synthesis format, and sub-agent model bindings.
Eliminated 'High Consigliere v5.0' ghost identity from operator-submitted tier proposal — no such identity exists in the Syndicate. Confidence gate wired to @lead, not a phantom role.

versions.description: Operative Tier & Task Queue Integration. Introduces The Operative agent (bounded execution tier), formalizes dispatch package protocol, integrates task queue into project-map.json, and clarifies orchestrator/executor hierarchy.
changelog: Added THE_OPERATIVE.md v1.0 — New fourth agent identity for bounded task execution with dispatch package contract.
Updated THE_LEAD.md v3.0 — Added Operative to delegation matrix, refined SDLC phases to include DISPATCH phase.
Updated THE_LEDGER.md v3.0 — Refined task queue protocol to generate dispatch packages for @operative instances, embedded task tracking in project-map.json.
Updated project-map.json template — Added task_queue section with task status tracking, dispatch package embedding, and operative assignment.
Updated README.md — Added Operative to agent team table, clarified orchestrator/executor architecture, updated directory structure.
Clarified agent hierarchy: Orchestrators (Lead, Ledger) govern strategy and planning; Gavel and Operative enforce quality and execute work.
Formalized dispatch package spec with required fields: task_definition, context, specification, audit_criteria.

versions.description: Branch-Based Mission Architecture. Adds mission-scoped vault isolation, syndicate-session.sh tmux manager with branch detection, Gavel pre-commit and commit-msg hooks, Mission Brief and project-map.json templates, and headless-first identity updates for all three agents.
changelog: Added syndicate-session.sh — tmux session manager with git branch detection and auto-loading of mission ORACLE.md and project-map.json.
Added Mission Mode to syndicate-init.sh (--mission flag) — verifies mission/ branch, creates .syndicate/vault/<branch-name>/, generates Mission Brief.
Added hooks/pre-commit — Gavel branch guard, Oracle integrity check, secrets scan, Oracle prohibited pattern guard.
Added hooks/commit-msg — enforces Syndicate-Audit-Trace trailer on all mission/ branch commits.
Added templates/MISSION_BRIEF.md — operator-completed mission context template.
Added templates/project-map.json — Ledger's branch-specific Gemini context map template.
Updated THE_LEAD.md v2.0 — Branch Integrity (refuse main commits, require Syndicate-Audit-Trace).
Updated THE_LEDGER.md v2.0 — Context Switch Protocol (detect branch change, swap project-map.json, announce context load).
Updated THE_GAVEL.md v2.0 — Pre-Commit Hook Mode, AUDIT_TRACE trailer output, headless/CLI-only operation.
All shims and identities updated for headless environment: API keys from $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / $GOOGLE_API_KEY only.

version_schema.description: Schema for future version entries. All versions must conform to this structure.

fields.version: Semver string (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). MAJOR = breaking identity changes. MINOR = new features, new agents, new shims. PATCH = fixes to existing files.
fields.agents: Map of agent handle to identity version, file path, and default model.
fields.shims_available: Array of shim config file paths included in this version.
fields.compatibility: Minimum required model versions and CLI tools.
fields.integrity: Release author and SHA-256 hash of manifest for tamper detection.

deployment_registry.description: Projects that have been hydrated from this Syndicate core. Entries are added by syndicate-init.sh at hydration time. This allows retroactive auditing of which Syndicate version was active for any given project.
